_comment: Pre-registered extended-training addendum (configs/extended_ctc_protocol.json), committed before training and before any new test inference. Identical to the original config except the training-length fields: max_steps, warmup_steps (kept at 10% of updates, as in the original allocation) and dev_eval_every (DEV-loss evaluation frequency). Motivation is DEV-only: the original run's full-DEV CTC loss had not converged. Original run/results are kept unchanged.
